hexes.ZhInfo: 降低25%攻击力。全属性提升10点
承受10倍伤害。提升40%攻击力
hexes.EnInfo: Take 10 times normal damage. Deal 40% more damage.

hexes.ZhInfo: 施放绝招后，回复100%绝招量表，45秒冷却
hexes.EnInfo: Restore 100% of the ultimate gauge after using an ultimate. 45s cooldown.

hexes.ZhInfo: 你的圣杯瓶数量翻倍，但回复量减半。使用圣杯瓶后，提升5%攻击力，持续15秒
hexes.EnInfo: Double your flask capacity, but halve flask healing. Using a flask increases damage by 5% for 15s.

hexes.ZhInfo: 血量不满时，持续消耗专注值来回复血量。血量全满时，使用圣杯瓶会回复50%专注值
hexes.EnInfo: When below full HP, continuously spend FP to restore HP. At full HP, using a flask restores 50% FP.

hexes.ZhInfo: 受到攻击时，由结晶外壳代为承受并破碎。结晶外壳破碎后需要40秒来重新生成
hexes.EnInfo: A crystal shell takes the hit for you and shatters. It regenerates after 40s.

hexes.ZhInfo: 获得无限攀爬能力。你的跳跃攻击随下落高度提升伤害。消除脚步声。受到攻击时，隐身1秒
hexes.EnInfo: Gain unlimited climbing. Your jump attacks deal more damage with greater fall height. Silence footsteps. Become invisible for 1s when hit.

hexes.ZhInfo: 你的魔法、祷告还会被视为近战攻击，但只能命中近身敌人，并基于该法术的射程提供吸血、增伤、咏唱时减伤率。你的法术咏唱变得不易被打断。提升15%近战攻击力
hexes.EnInfo: Spells also count as melee attacks, but only hit nearby enemies. Gain lifesteal, bonus damage and casting damage reduction based on spell range. Spellcasting is harder to interrupt. Gain 15% melee attack power.

hexes.ZhInfo: 提升攻击成功时的冲击力
血量偏低时，在10秒内加快行动并提升60%减伤率，60秒冷却
hexes.EnInfo: At low HP, double action speed and gain 60% damage negation for 10s. 60s cooldown.

hexes.ZhInfo: 强化后跃的闪避能力。后跃攻击进行反击或正面处决敌人时，回复25%绝招量表。翻滚或受到损伤时，损失30%绝招量表。你的后跃攻击随绝招量表提升最多200%伤害
hexes.EnInfo: Enhance backstep evasion. Other dodges cost 30% Art gauge. Backstep attacks that hit enemies whose stance is not broken restore 25%. Frontal critical hits restore 25%. Taking damage costs 30%. Backstep attacks gain bonus damage equal to twice your current Art gauge percentage.

hexes.ZhInfo: 你的战技不消耗专注值。每次施放战技后，重铸该武器的战技
hexes.EnInfo: Your skills cost no FP. After using a skill, reforge that weapon's skill.

hexes.ZhInfo: 标记自己位置时，形成熔岩，期间你每次标记自己都会为这颗熔岩提升伤害
hexes.EnInfo: Mark your own position to form lava. Mark yourself again before it erupts to empower that lava

hexes.ZhInfo: 你无需钥匙就能打开监牢，且释放的敌人更加多样。攻略监牢后，不会生成赐福，但你可以重复打开同一个监牢。每座封印监牢最多开启5次
hexes.EnInfo: Allows evergaols to be opened without a Stonesword Key, releasing a wider variety of enemies. Defeating the prisoners does not create a Site of Grace, but allows the same evergaol to be opened again. Each evergaol can be opened up to five times.

hexes.ZhInfo: 血量上限提升50%。减伤率降低30%。对突刺的减伤率额外降低50%。阵亡或濒死时爆炸，对附近敌人造成等同于你血量上限的伤害
hexes.EnInfo: Maximum HP +50%. Reduces damage negation by 30%. Further reduces damage negation against piercing attacks by 50%. Upon death or near-death, explode and deal damage equal to your maximum HP to nearby enemies.

hexes.ZhInfo: 储存打倒的强敌的灵魂，优先保留血量上限更高的灵魂。施放绝招时，同时释放出储存的灵魂，短时间内为你作战
hexes.EnInfo: Store the soul of a powerful enemy defeated by your team, replacing it only with one that had higher maximum HP. Using your Ultimate Art consumes the stored soul and summons its spirit to fight for you. The spirit loses 1/60 of its maximum HP each second and deals 25% of its original damage.

hexes.ZhInfo: 魔法、祷告蓄力时，每秒回复30点精力值
hexes.EnInfo: Restore 30 stamina per second while charging a sorcery or incantation.

validation: Mighty excludes Revenant/Recluse from random and preferred rewards. Texts updated; runtime projectile handling and regulation unchanged. Gameplay pending.
